s0201.literal: On bingyin day the seals and letters originally issued to various merchants by the Treasury Bureau were confiscated.
s0201.idiomatic: On bingyin day the seals and letters originally issued to various merchants by the Treasury Bureau were confiscated.

s0202.literal: On dingmao day the tribute wine made by Zhigechi Balahesun was abolished.
s0202.idiomatic: On dingmao day the tribute wine made by Zhigechi Balahesun was abolished.

s0203.literal: On wuchen day an edict directed that princes arriving late to the assembly be given gifts according to precedent.
s0203.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict directed that princes arriving late to the assembly be given gifts according to precedent.

s0204.literal: On jisi day Prince Wei Amuge had an audience; the Emperor told provincial officials, saying: "Amuge and I share the same father but different mothers; if I do not support him, on whom can he rely?
s0204.idiomatic: On jisi day Prince Wei Amuge had an audience; the Emperor told provincial officials, saying, "Amuge and I share the same father but different mothers; if I do not support him, on whom can he rely?

s0205.literal: Grant him twenty thousand ingots of notes; do not cite this as precedent for others."
s0205.idiomatic: Grant him 20,000 ingots of notes; do not cite this as precedent for others."

s0206.literal: " The Emperor, reading the Essentials of Government from the Zhenguan Reign, told Hanlin lecturer Alin Temür, saying: "This book benefits the state; translate it into the national language, print and circulate it, and have Mongols and semuren learn and recite it.
s0206.idiomatic: The Emperor, reading the Essentials of Government from the Zhenguan Reign, told Hanlin lecturer Alin Temür, "This book benefits the state; translate it into the national language, print and circulate it, and have Mongols and semuren learn and recite it.

s0207.literal: " Jining, Dongping, Guide, Gaotang, Xu, and Pi prefectures suffered flooding; notes were issued for relief.
s0207.idiomatic: Jining, Dongping, Guide, Gaotang, Xu, and Pi prefectures suffered flooding; notes were issued for relief.

s0208.literal: Various counties in Hejian and Shaanxi suffered flood and drought damage to crops; officials were ordered to provide relief and remit this year's land tax.
s0208.idiomatic: Various counties in Hejian and Shaanxi suffered flood and drought damage to crops; officials were ordered to provide relief and remit this year's land tax.

s0209.literal: Prince Talaimade dispatched envoys presenting tame elephants.
s0209.idiomatic: Prince Talaimade dispatched envoys presenting tame elephants.

s0210.literal: Seventh month, autumn, on xinwei new moon: round tallies, seals and letters, and relay vouchers by which Liaoyang provincial officials directed various affairs were confiscated and returned; Tiger Guard Bureau staff was reduced; impoverished guards at Shangdu were granted one hundred thirty-nine thousand ingots of notes.
s0210.idiomatic: Seventh month, autumn, on xinwei new moon: round tallies, seals and letters, and relay vouchers by which Liaoyang provincial officials directed various affairs were confiscated and returned; Tiger Guard Bureau staff was reduced; impoverished guards at Shangdu were granted 139,000 ingots of notes.

s0211.literal: On dingchou day Ningyuan County of Gongchang suffered torrential rain; mountain earth flowed in torrents.
s0211.idiomatic: On dingchou day Ningyuan County of Gongchang suffered torrential rain; mountain earth flowed in torrents.

s0212.literal: An edict directed that military officers inner and outer all be granted one grade in nominal rank.
s0212.idiomatic: An edict directed that military officers inner and outer all be granted one grade in nominal rank.

s0213.literal: On guiwei day Ganzhou suffered earthquake and strong wind, with sounds like thunder.
s0213.idiomatic: On guiwei day Ganzhou suffered earthquake and strong wind, with sounds like thunder.

s0214.literal: For the assembly, Prince Tuman was graciously granted one hundred fifty taels of gold, five thousand two hundred fifty taels of silver, and three thousand bolts of silks and cloths.
s0214.idiomatic: For the assembly, Prince Tuman was graciously granted 150 taels of gold, 5,250 taels of silver, and 3,000 bolts of silks and cloths.

s0215.literal: On yiyou day Prince Xiangning Dieligebuhua's following was granted thirty-two thousand ingots of notes.
s0215.idiomatic: On yiyou day Prince Xiangning Dieligebuhua's following was granted 32,000 ingots of notes.

s0216.literal: On guisi day the moon eclipsed Bi.
s0216.idiomatic: On guisi day the moon eclipsed Bi.

s0217.literal: On jiawu day the Directorate for Rectifying Pasturage was established to administer Mongol military pasture lands, at third rank, with five officials.
s0217.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Directorate for Rectifying Pasturage was established to administer Mongol military pasture lands, at third rank, with five officials.

s0218.literal: On dingyou day the moon encroached upon the Ghost asterism's distancing star.
s0218.idiomatic: On dingyou day the moon encroached upon the Ghost asterism's distancing star.

s0219.literal: On jihai day an edict told provincial officials, saying: "I previously warned close attendants not casually to relay orders to the central secretariat in written notes; from now on whoever dares violate this need not be reported — directly seize the person and deliver him to the Ministry of Justice for investigation and punishment.
s0219.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict told provincial officials, saying, "I previously warned close attendants not casually to relay orders to the central secretariat in written notes; from now on whoever dares violate this need not be reported — directly seize the person and deliver him to the Ministry of Justice for investigation and punishment.

s0220.literal: " An edict directed censorate officials to select experienced and mature men as surveillance censors; palace domestic service commissioner Bosu was specially promoted to Grand Master for Palace Attendance and Grand Councillor of the Imperial Clan Court.
s0220.idiomatic: An edict directed censorate officials to select experienced and mature men as surveillance censors; palace domestic service commissioner Bosu was specially promoted to Grand Master for Palace Attendance and Grand Councillor of the Imperial Clan Court.

s0221.literal: That month, subordinate counties of Jiangling suffered flood and many people died; Taiyuan, Hejian, Zhending, Shunde, Zhangde, Daming, Guangping and other circuits, and De, Pu, En, Tong and other prefectures suffered crop damage from rains; Ning and other circuits had frost; officials were ordered to provide relief.
s0221.idiomatic: That month, subordinate counties of Jiangling suffered flood and many people died; Taiyuan, Hejian, Zhending, Shunde, Zhangde, Daming, Guangping and other circuits, and De, Pu, En, Tong and other prefectures suffered crop damage from rains; Ning and other circuits had frost; officials were ordered to provide relief.

s0222.literal: Intercalary seventh month, on xinchou day, National University rector Liu Geng was ordered to go to Qufu and sacrifice to Confucius with the grand offering.
s0222.idiomatic: Intercalary seventh month, on xinchou day, National University rector Liu Geng was ordered to go to Qufu and sacrifice to Confucius with the grand offering.

s0223.literal: On jiachen day, as the imperial carriage was about to return to Dadu, the empress dowager, because autumn crops were flourishing, directed that hawking offices, camel handlers, and guards not go ahead, so as to avoid harming crops and disturbing the people — an edict forbade it.
s0223.idiomatic: On jiachen day, as the imperial carriage was about to return to Dadu, the empress dowager, because autumn crops were flourishing, directed that hawking offices, camel handlers, and guards not go ahead, so as to avoid harming crops and disturbing the people — an edict forbade it.

s0224.literal: The Privy Council memorialized, saying: "Juyong Pass has forty-three old routes; military officials guard only thirteen of them; formerly thousand-household offices were established, but rank was low while responsibility was heavy — we request establishing the Longzhen Ten-Thousand-Household Office to enforce strict defense.
s0224.idiomatic: The Privy Council memorialized, saying, "Juyong Pass has 43 old routes; military officials guard only 13 of them; formerly thousand-household offices were established, but rank was low while responsibility was heavy — we request establishing the Longzhen Ten-Thousand-Household Office to enforce strict defense.

s0226.literal: " Star rites for the five planets were performed at the Directorate of Astronomy.
s0226.idiomatic: Star rites for the five planets were performed at the Directorate of Astronomy.

s0227.literal: The former Prince of Lu Diaogebala's legitimate son Arigajasaili inherited his enfeoffment title and fief.
s0227.idiomatic: The former Prince of Lu Diaogebala's legitimate son Arigajasaili inherited his enfeoffment title and fief.

s0228.literal: On yisi day, for the assembly, Yuechicha'er and Chuangwu'er were graciously granted two hundred taels of gold, two thousand eight hundred taels of silver, and silks and cloths in varying amounts.
s0228.idiomatic: On yisi day, for the assembly, Yuechicha'er and Chuangwu'er were graciously granted 200 taels of gold, 2,800 taels of silver, and silks and cloths in varying amounts.

s0229.literal: On bingwu day Wuzong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0229.idiomatic: On bingwu day Wuzong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0230.literal: On wushen day Li Meng was enfeoffed Duke of Qin State; Yeliqanqiresi was made Minister of Education.
s0230.idiomatic: On wushen day Li Meng was enfeoffed Duke of Qin State; Yeliqanqiresi was made Minister of Education.

s0231.literal: On jiyou day Tibetans raided Lidian and Wenzhou; Commander Yeliqan and others were ordered to subdue them.
s0231.idiomatic: On jiyou day Tibetans raided Lidian and Wenzhou; Commander Yeliqan and others were ordered to subdue them.

s0232.literal: On xinhai day the Western monk Zangbubanba was made State Preceptor and granted a jade seal.
s0232.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Western monk Zangbubanba was made State Preceptor and granted a jade seal.

s0233.literal: On wuwu day the Directorate of Sacrificial Rites was restored.
s0233.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Directorate of Sacrificial Rites was restored.

s0234.literal: On jiwei day an edict told provincial officials, saying: "The National University — Emperor Shizu deeply attended to it; men like Grand Councillor Buqa were Mongols, yet were educated to become accomplished.
s0234.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict told provincial officials, saying, "The National University — Emperor Shizu deeply attended to it; men like Grand Councillor Buqa were Mongols, yet were educated to become accomplished.

s0235.literal: I have now personally fixed the National University student quota at three hundred persons; twenty additional hall-attendant students are added; those who master one classic are to be appointed as study companions in order — established as a fixed regulation."
s0235.idiomatic: I have now personally fixed the National University student quota at 300 persons; 20 additional hall-attendant students are added; those who master one classic are to be appointed as study companions in order — established as a fixed regulation."

s0236.literal: " An edict directed: "Military officers retire at seventy before sons and younger brothers may inherit posts.
s0236.idiomatic: An edict directed, "Military officers retire at seventy before sons and younger brothers may inherit posts.

s0237.literal: Those who while not yet old feign illness to claim advanced age and allow young sons and brothers to inherit posts — expunge their names and permit no further appointment;
s0237.idiomatic: Those who while not yet old feign illness to claim advanced age and allow young sons and brothers to inherit posts — expunge their names and permit no further appointment;

s0238.literal: those who use scheming to seek transfer — prosecuted as violation of regulations."
s0238.idiomatic: those who use scheming to seek transfer — prosecuted as violation of regulations."

s0239.literal: " On renxu day relief was ordered for displaced persons north of the passes.
s0239.idiomatic: On renxu day relief was ordered for displaced persons north of the passes.

s0240.literal: At Shangdu a Communications Office was established to administer Mongol relay stations, at second rank.
s0240.idiomatic: At Shangdu a Communications Office was established to administer Mongol relay stations, at second rank.

s0241.literal: On jiazi day Ningxia suffered earthquake.
s0241.idiomatic: On jiazi day Ningxia suffered earthquake.

s0242.literal: On yichou day Grand Princess of Lu State Sangqijie was advanced in title to Elder Imperial Sister Grand Princess.
s0242.idiomatic: On yichou day Grand Princess of Lu State Sangqijie was advanced in title to Elder Imperial Sister Grand Princess.

s0243.literal: Envoys were dispatched to win over and announce to the Black Water, White Water, and other tribes — more than one hundred twenty thousand households came to submit.
s0243.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to win over and announce to the Black Water, White Water, and other tribes — more than 120,000 households came to submit.

s0244.literal: On bingyin day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.
s0244.idiomatic: On bingyin day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.

s0245.literal: Princes Abuhua and others were granted two hundred taels of gold, seven hundred fifty taels of silver, thirteen thousand six hundred thirty ingots of notes, and silks and cloths in varying amounts.
s0245.idiomatic: Princes Abuhua and others were granted 200 taels of gold, 750 taels of silver, 13,630 ingots of notes, and silks and cloths in varying amounts.

s0246.literal: On dingmao day Wanze, Li Meng, and others said: "At present Confucians are being advanced to office, yet mature men daily fade away; accomplished Confucian scholars from all quarters — we request selecting them for posts such as National University, Hanlin, Secretariat, Grand Ceremony, or Confucianism intendant, so scholars have incentive.
s0246.idiomatic: On dingmao day Wanze, Li Meng, and others said, "At present Confucians are being advanced to office, yet mature men daily fade away; accomplished Confucian scholars from all quarters — we request selecting them for posts such as National University, Hanlin, Secretariat, Grand Ceremony, or Confucianism intendant, so scholars have incentive.

s0247.literal: " The Emperor said: "Your words are correct.
s0247.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Your words are correct.

s0248.literal: From now on do not limit by qualification grade; if truly talented and worthy, even men without office may be employed."
s0248.idiomatic: From now on do not limit by qualification grade; if truly talented and worthy, even men without office may be employed."

s0249.literal: " An edict directed direct-reporting secretariat attendants to serve half in the palace hall and half at the central secretariat's disposal.
s0249.idiomatic: An edict directed direct-reporting secretariat attendants to serve half in the palace hall and half at the central secretariat's disposal.

s0250.literal: Physicians who had not passed selection examinations and were not registered were forbidden to practice medicine.
s0250.idiomatic: Physicians who had not passed selection examinations and were not registered were forbidden to practice medicine.

s0251.literal: Xuanning County of Datong suffered hail; it piled five cun deep and seedlings and crops were entirely destroyed.
s0251.idiomatic: Xuanning County of Datong suffered hail; it piled five cun deep and seedlings and crops were entirely destroyed.

s0252.literal: Eighth month, on jisi new moon: establishment numbers for metropolitan offices were fixed according to the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan old quotas.
s0252.idiomatic: Eighth month, on jisi new moon: establishment numbers for metropolitan offices were fixed according to the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan old quotas.

s0253.literal: Prince Yahu of Chu's following lacked food; ten thousand ingots of notes were issued and five thousand shi of grain dispensed for relief.
s0253.idiomatic: Prince Yahu of Chu's following lacked food; 10,000 ingots of notes were issued and 5,000 shi of grain dispensed for relief.

s0254.literal: Palace guard grooms were granted thirty thousand ingots of notes; close attendant Quelieshi was made Minister of Revenue.
s0254.idiomatic: Palace guard grooms were granted 30,000 ingots of notes; close attendant Quelieshi was made Minister of Revenue.

s0255.literal: On jiaxu day the Elder Imperial Sister Grand Princess was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0255.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Elder Imperial Sister Grand Princess was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0256.literal: On bingxu day Chen Rikuo, heir of Annan, presented a memorial and local products in tribute.
s0256.idiomatic: On bingxu day Chen Rikuo, heir of Annan, presented a memorial and local products in tribute.

s0257.literal: An edict directed that Western Tibet military affairs be subordinate to the Commission for Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs.
s0257.idiomatic: An edict directed that Western Tibet military affairs be subordinate to the Commission for Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs.

s0258.literal: Ninth month, on jihai new moon: remotely appointed left chancellor Buqa was promoted to Grand Marshal.
s0258.idiomatic: Ninth month, on jihai new moon: remotely appointed left chancellor Buqa was promoted to Grand Marshal.

s0259.literal: On bingwu day remotely appointed Huguang grand councillor and King of Annan Chen Yiji had an audience, saying: "Since I came to allegiance in Emperor Shizu's reign, my wife and children were all killed by my countrymen; the court granted me a royal title and also gave five hundred qing of fields at Hanyang, enabling self-support to end my years.
s0259.idiomatic: On bingwu day remotely appointed Huguang grand councillor and King of Annan Chen Yiji had an audience, saying, "Since I came to allegiance in Emperor Shizu's reign, my wife and children were all killed by my countrymen; the court granted me a royal title and also gave 500 qing of fields at Hanyang, enabling self-support to end my years.

s0260.literal: Now I am nearly seventy, yet officials constrain the fields granted me — I have nowhere to obtain food."
s0260.idiomatic: Now I am nearly seventy, yet officials constrain the fields granted me — I have nowhere to obtain food."

s0261.literal: " The Emperor told provincial officials, saying: "The King of Annan came to allegiance out of righteous admiration — his grants should be generous, to win distant peoples; his advanced merit rank and receipt of fields remain as before.
s0261.idiomatic: The Emperor told provincial officials, saying, "The King of Annan came to allegiance out of righteous admiration — his grants should be generous, to win distant peoples; his advanced merit rank and receipt of fields remain as before.

s0262.literal: " On wushen day the people were forbidden to shoot flying birds and to kill horses, cattle, or sheep that were nursing.
s0262.idiomatic: On wushen day the people were forbidden to shoot flying birds and to kill horses, cattle, or sheep that were nursing.

s0263.literal: Guards were forbidden to privately wear banquet service robes or pawn them to others.
s0263.idiomatic: Guards were forbidden to privately wear banquet service robes or pawn them to others.

s0264.literal: On gengxu day the Privy Council was ordered to review military horses of each province.
s0264.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Privy Council was ordered to review military horses of each province.

s0265.literal: On renzi day the era was changed to Huangqing; an edict said: "We rely on the spirits of Heaven and Earth and the ancestral spirits, succeeding the holy lineage, ever reflecting on the greatness of ancient governance, all living things flourishing, the state at peace.
s0265.idiomatic: On renzi day the era was changed to Huangqing; an edict said, "We rely on the spirits of Heaven and Earth and the ancestral spirits, succeeding the holy lineage, ever reflecting on the greatness of ancient governance, all living things flourishing, the state at peace.

s0266.literal: We rise early and sleep late, not daring neglect; appointing the worthy and employing the capable, reviving the stagnant and filling gaps — We hope thereby to attain the five blessings of this age and broadly bestow them upon the multitude — this is Our aspiration.
s0266.idiomatic: We rise early and sleep late, not daring neglect; appointing the worthy and employing the capable, reviving the stagnant and filling gaps — We hope thereby to attain the five blessings of this age and broadly bestow them upon the multitude — this is Our aspiration.

s0267.literal: Changing the era name after a full year has its constant precedent; let the fifth year of Zhida become the first year of Huangqing."
s0267.idiomatic: Changing the era name after a full year has its constant precedent; let the fifth year of Zhida become the first year of Huangqing."

s0268.literal: " Director of Waterworks Mubalasah relayed an order to take relay posts and fetch the dragon boat built at Hangzhou; provincial officials remonstrated, saying: "Your Majesty has ascended the throne and proclaimed to all under Heaven that all items not expressly requisitioned must not be presumptuously presented.
s0268.idiomatic: Director of Waterworks Mubalasah relayed an order to take relay posts and fetch the dragon boat built at Hangzhou; provincial officials remonstrated, saying, "Your Majesty has ascended the throne and proclaimed to all under Heaven that all items not expressly requisitioned must not be presumptuously presented.

s0269.literal: Truly to take this boat would contradict the earlier edict."
s0269.idiomatic: Truly to take this boat would contradict the earlier edict."

s0271.literal: The Empress's Establishment Qielian Household Various Artisans Hunting and Hawking Overall Directorate was restored, at third rank.
s0271.idiomatic: The Empress's Establishment Qielian Household Various Artisans Hunting and Hawking Overall Directorate was restored, at third rank.

s0272.literal: On yimao day the moon encroached upon Bi.
s0272.idiomatic: On yimao day the moon encroached upon Bi.

s0273.literal: On dingsi day, by the empress dowager's order, Yongping Route's annual revenue, aside from operating expenses, was entirely granted to the Grand Princess of Lu State.
s0273.idiomatic: On dingsi day, by the empress dowager's order, Yongping Route's annual revenue, aside from operating expenses, was entirely granted to the Grand Princess of Lu State.

s0274.literal: Prince of Yunnan Lao's following was granted twelve thousand ingots of notes for horse prices.
s0274.idiomatic: Prince of Yunnan Lao's following was granted 12,000 ingots of notes for horse prices.

s0275.literal: On bingyin day provincial and ministry officials were directed not to use palace guard duty as pretext to neglect office.
s0275.idiomatic: On bingyin day provincial and ministry officials were directed not to use palace guard duty as pretext to neglect office.

s0276.literal: The Western Tibet tea intendant office was abolished.
s0276.idiomatic: The Western Tibet tea intendant office was abolished.

s0277.literal: That month Jiangling Route's flood washed away people's dwellings; eighteen drowned.
s0277.idiomatic: That month Jiangling Route's flood washed away people's dwellings; 18 drowned.

s0278.literal: Tenth month, winter, on wuchen new moon: rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0278.idiomatic: Tenth month, winter, on wuchen new moon: rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0279.literal: On jisi day Wuzong's imperial portrait was ordered painted and installed at Great Chongen-Fuyuan Monastery, with sacrifice four times monthly.
s0279.idiomatic: On jisi day Wuzong's imperial portrait was ordered painted and installed at Great Chongen-Fuyuan Monastery, with sacrifice four times monthly.

s0280.literal: On xinwei day Great Pujing Monastery was granted one thousand taels of gold, five thousand taels of silver, ten thousand ingots of notes, ten thousand bolts of Western brocade, colored silks, gauze, thin silk, and cloth, eighty thousand mu of fields, and four hundred shop-houses.
s0280.idiomatic: On xinwei day Great Pujing Monastery was granted 1,000 taels of gold, 5,000 taels of silver, 10,000 ingots of notes, 10,000 bolts of Western brocade, colored silks, gauze, thin silk, and cloth, 80,000 mu of fields, and 400 shop-houses.

s0281.literal: On dingchou day Buddhist monasteries were forbidden to encroach on and seize commoners' fields under false pretenses.
s0281.idiomatic: On dingchou day Buddhist monasteries were forbidden to encroach on and seize commoners' fields under false pretenses.

s0282.literal: On xinsi day the Commission for Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs' judicial inquiry of Buddhist monks' lawsuits was abolished.
s0282.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Commission for Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs' judicial inquiry of Buddhist monks' lawsuits was abolished.

s0283.literal: The Qichun Ten-Thousand-Household Office garrisoned Qingyuan; the Shaoxing Coastal Ten-Thousand-Household Office garrisoned Chuzhou; the Suzhou Ten-Thousand-Household Office also garrisoned Taizhou.
s0283.idiomatic: The Qichun Ten-Thousand-Household Office garrisoned Qingyuan; the Shaoxing Coastal Ten-Thousand-Household Office garrisoned Chuzhou; the Suzhou Ten-Thousand-Household Office also garrisoned Taizhou.

s0284.literal: On wuzi day sea-route grain transport ten-thousand-household officials were reduced to six posts and thousand-household offices to seven units.
s0284.idiomatic: On wuzi day sea-route grain transport ten-thousand-household officials were reduced to 6 posts and thousand-household offices to 7 units.

s0285.literal: The late Grand Preceptor Yelülu's son Mulahu was specially granted Grand Councillor of the Imperial Clan Court and made privy council administrator.
s0285.idiomatic: The late Grand Preceptor Yelülu's son Mulahu was specially granted Grand Councillor of the Imperial Clan Court and made privy council administrator.

s0286.literal: On xinmao day princes' judicial officials were abolished; Mongols committing theft or fraud were ordered tried by their affiliated thousand-household offices.
s0286.idiomatic: On xinmao day princes' judicial officials were abolished; Mongols committing theft or fraud were ordered tried by their affiliated thousand-household offices.

s0287.literal: On renchen day an edict ordered collection of Zhida silver notes.
s0287.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict ordered collection of Zhida silver notes.

s0288.literal: An edict directed Han troops of all guards to drill in military matters.
s0288.idiomatic: An edict directed Han troops of all guards to drill in military matters.

s0289.literal: The Directorate of Herds was established at third rank to administer livestock under the Xingsheng Palace establishment.
s0289.idiomatic: The Directorate of Herds was established at third rank to administer livestock under the Xingsheng Palace establishment.

s0290.literal: On guisi day an edict established land-tax intendant offices at Bianliang, Pingjiang, and elsewhere to administer the assets of Great Chenghua-Pujing Monastery.
s0290.idiomatic: On guisi day an edict established land-tax intendant offices at Bianliang, Pingjiang, and elsewhere to administer the assets of Great Chenghua-Pujing Monastery.

s0291.literal: Additional garrison troops in Yunnan were granted twenty-five thousand ingots of notes.
s0291.idiomatic: Additional garrison troops in Yunnan were granted 25,000 ingots of notes.

s0292.literal: On bingshen day Venus encroached upon Lei Bi Formation.
s0292.idiomatic: On bingshen day Venus encroached upon Lei Bi Formation.

s0293.literal: Eleventh month, on wuxu day Minister of Education Maishi was enfeoffed Duke of Zhao State.
s0293.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on wuxu day Minister of Education Maishi was enfeoffed Duke of Zhao State.

s0294.literal: On xinchou day garrison-farm troops of Yan'an, Fengxiang, and Anxi at Hongcheng were ordered back to Shaanxi garrison-farm service.
s0294.idiomatic: On xinchou day garrison-farm troops of Yan'an, Fengxiang, and Anxi at Hongcheng were ordered back to Shaanxi garrison-farm service.

s0295.literal: An edict directed: "Commerce-tax officials who embezzle tax receipts — same as official corruption offenses.
s0295.idiomatic: An edict directed, "Commerce-tax officials who embezzle tax receipts — same as official corruption offenses.

s0296.literal: " Guaixi Prefecture was established, with native official Ama administering its affairs, wearing a gold tally.
s0296.idiomatic: Guaixi Prefecture was established, with native official Ama administering its affairs, wearing a gold tally.

s0297.literal: Li Meng memorialized, saying: "Revenue and grain are the state's foundation; in Emperor Shizu's reign expenditures matched income and economy was always pursued, hence storehouses were full.
s0297.idiomatic: Li Meng memorialized, saying, "Revenue and grain are the state's foundation; in Emperor Shizu's reign expenditures matched income and economy was always pursued, hence storehouses were full.

s0298.literal: Now each year more than six million ingots are disbursed; moreover more than a hundred construction projects consume several million ingots; inner-court directive grants use another three million-plus ingots; northern frontier military needs again six or seven million ingots;
s0298.idiomatic: Now each year more than 6 million ingots are disbursed; moreover more than 100 construction projects consume several million ingots; inner-court directive grants use another 3 million-plus ingots; northern frontier military needs again 6 or 7 million ingots;

s0299.literal: yet the treasury currently stores only a little over one hundred ten thousand ingots — how can this suffice?
s0299.idiomatic: yet the treasury currently stores only a little over 110,000 ingots — how can this suffice?

s0300.literal: From now on all non-urgent superfluous expenditures should be entirely halted."
s0300.idiomatic: From now on all non-urgent superfluous expenditures should be entirely halted."
